head.title: breeze

div.h1: Grading that keeps up with your classroom.
div.p: Track assignments, attendance and progress in one place, and share reports with students and families.

div.label: Search engine
div.p: Where homepage and address bar searches are sent.
Light, dark, or follow your device.
The color used for selected and active items. Applies instantly.

div.label: Font
div.p: Loaded the first time you pick it.

div.label: Interface size
div.p: Scale text and controls up or down together.
Motion when menus, tabs and pages open.
Frosted, see-through panels, buttons and menus. Looks best over a background.
Your own image behind the homepage. Upload one or paste a link; uploads stay on this device.

div.label: Background dim
div.p: Darken or lighten the image so text stays readable.
The faint grid pattern behind the homepage.

div.label: Preset
div.p: Fills in the title and icon below in one click.

div.label: Tab title
div.p: Shown instead of "breeze". Blank keeps it.

div.label: Tab icon
div.p: An image url to use as the tab's icon.

div.label: Launch mode
div.p: Reopen breeze inside an about:blank or blob tab so its real address never reaches your history. Needs popups allowed, and launches on your first click each visit.
Only disguise while you are on another tab.
Ask before the tab closes or navigates away.
Swaps letters for lookalikes so extensions scanning the page can't match words.
Sends you somewhere safe instantly, even from inside a site or game. Esc cancels recording.

div.label: Panic url
div.p: Where the panic key sends you.

div.label: Wisp server
div.p: The websocket server the proxy connects through. Blank uses the default; reload to apply.
breeze
built by x8rr

iframe.title: Game
iframe.sandbox: allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-pointer-lock allow-orientation-lock allow-presentation allow-modals allow-downloads
